verdict.rationale: Warp's own marketing states that tax registrations, filings, and payments are handled automatically across all 50 states. That directly covers automatic state-level filing and remittance, and its Warp Agent is described as handling payroll and tax notices. Federal and local taxes are not explicitly named, and tax calculation is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit federal and local tax coverage, documented tax calculation, in-depth first-party tax docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have federal, state, and local payroll taxes calculated, filed, and remitted automatically

citations.quote: Tax registrations, filings, and payments handled automatically across all 50 states.
